parsed.rationale: Both `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 38 in HLSPlayerMessages.swift) and `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 42 in RadioPlayerMessages.swift) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Because the implementations are identical and neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift fix is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `PlaybackMessage`) with a default implementation of `makeNotification` in a protocol extension, allowing both message types to inherit the behaviour without repeating it. A suitable home for the protocol and its extension already exists within the `Playback` package, avoiding any new dependency.
